allocation_input_policy.alignment: common-date intersection of NET returns before any allocator call
allocation_input_policy.locked_oos_role: report-only out-of-sample evaluation of the pre-registered weights

allocation_layering.layer_1_relative: allocator (hrp_dendrogram primary + variants): HOW to split among risky sleeves; weights sum to 1; mu-free
allocation_layering.layer_2_exposure: risk_scaling target_vol: HOW MUCH total risky exposure L = min(max_leverage, sigma_target/sigma_hat); residual 1-L is risk-free cash; only sigma_hat is estimated
allocation_layering.layer_3_growth: fractional Kelly: growth-optimal L = f*mu_hat/sigma_hat^2 -- gated because it re-imports mu-hat error; pre-registered as a variant, never the primary until locked-OOS mu evidence exists
allocation_layering.rationale: Deliberate separation so the Markowitz's-curse mitigation of the mu-free allocator is not undone by a mu-dependent sizing layer on top.

allocator.notes: Full Lopez de Prado dendrogram HRP (single linkage) is the pre-registered primary; the variants below are run on the SAME materialized input for comparison, never cherry-picked.

risk_scaling.cash_note: final weights = L * w (allocator weights sum to 1); the residual 1-L is the cash weight recorded as the manifest's cash_weight. The simulator accrues NO interest on idle cash (RiskFreePolicy is the excess-return benchmark for Sharpe/Sortino only); a real risk-free yield on the residual is a live-deployment detail outside the backtest
risk_scaling.estimation: sigma_hat = std of the common-date aligned train+validation NET portfolio stream under the allocator's relative weights; the ONLY estimate consumed (no mu forecast anywhere in the primary path)

variants.note: Kelly re-introduces the mu-hat estimation problem the mu-free allocators avoid (an overestimated mean scales exposure linearly); resolve_risk_scaling_spec fails closed until mu_evidence_confirmed is set true on locked-OOS evidence. Until then it is exercised only through the kelly_mu_sensitivity diagnostic in compare_hierarchical_allocators.py.
